notes.title: Game Reveal!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Snipers,[/h1]

We just announced Center Mass: Streets of Ramadi! 🚨

The game challenges you to step into the boots of an elite sniper and experience authentic modern combat. It has:

🪖 An immersive simulation experience
🔫 Realistic weapon handling
🏜️High-stakes environments
👥 Cooperative gameplay

You can find more information such as the list of features on the main game page. And while there, don't forget to give Center Mass a Wishlist. It helps a ton. 

Also, don't forget to check out our first trailer!

[previewyoutube=VJ_QA1PXdjM;full][/previewyoutube]
